name: Two Walks and Progressive Link
notes: Owner's description: walk forward slow, slow; then quick, quick into promenade. Walks and Progressive Link as in the book (the owner's video matches): on the first quick he steps forward in CBMP and she back; on the second his right foot lands beside and slightly behind his left with little travel, while she steps to the side turning 1/4 right into promenade. He doesn't turn. Walks are straight (real tango walks curve gradually left), with no rise. Provisional: step sizes, and her back step setting off straight back past his right foot. 2/4: a slow is one beat.

lead.label: side and slightly back, small step, into promenade

follow.label: side and slightly back, turning to promenade
